headline: Divided Fronts Register Fresh Strategic Exchanges
war_summary: Since the last edition, the strategic ledgers have shifted most sharply in the contested belts. Fisherman’s Row now records 38 events in 24 hours, including ten in the latest two-hour window, while its holdings stand at eight Warden bases and one Colonial. Lykos Isle has reached 14 daily events, with five in the latest two hours, and remains divided at two Warden, four Colonial, and one neutral base. Weathered Expanse has added fresh movement to reach nine events, including two recently, and its ledger now reads five Warden to four Colonial. Deadlands has five events, two in the latest watch, with six Colonial and five Warden holdings. Stlican Shelf has also stirred, registering one recent event among eight for the day and standing at eight Warden to one Colonial. Farranac Coast remains contested at seven Colonial and four Warden bases, though its 11-event daily record shows no activity in the latest two hours. Heavy casualty traffic continues in several other sectors, but most report no recent strategic-base exchange; the war remains without a declared victor.
